title: Evaluate duplicate, reordered, and stale event handling
objective: Produce evidence-backed requirements, architecture alternatives, real local experiment contracts, and unapproved implementation proposals for an event consumer. Do not claim knowledge of private vendor internals. Evaluate the arrival-order hypothesis first; revise it if actual observations falsify it.
scope: Public architectural research with captured quote provenance
Deterministic duplicate and reorder experiments using the declared local Python bundle
non_goals: Accounts, credentials, GPU access or paid services
constraints: Ask the operator whether acknowledgement requires durable storage before accepting the durability requirement
Use only explicitly enrolled experiment profiles and frozen bundles

Use experiment contract ID event-ordering with bundle_files [experiments/event-ordering/experiment.py], copied byte-for-byte from the reviewed experiment.py seed, and profile event-ordering-python; select exactly one argument arrival or versioned for each separately approved frozen contract

Use separate experiment contract ID stale-writer with bundle_files [experiments/stale-writer/experiment.py], copied byte-for-byte from the same seed, profile stale-writer-python, and exactly one argument fenced
Require exact architecture and each experiment approval before execution
Do not represent missing infrastructure or incomplete output as falsification
